annotations.title: Explain how a new unit was formed

description: Explain what a NEW (post-1 July 2025) commune or province was formed from: the old communes or provinces merged into it, whether each came whole or partially (split communes list the other new units their parts went to), the transition type and the resolution numbers. Use when the user asks "which wards were merged into X" or needs the legal basis. Takes the new unit code (5 digits for a commune, 2 for a province); get it from find_units or convert_old_to_new. Examples: {"code":"26734"}; {"code":"79"}.

code.description: Code of a NEW unit: 5-digit commune code (e.g. "26734") or 2-digit province code (e.g. "79").
